test_title: PYST 2:SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On:14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Identify how you will ask everyone if the children were not reading the books in passive voice.

options.text: Were the books being read by the children?
Were the books not being read by the children?
Were the book not being read by the children?
Were the children reading the books?

solution:
The correct answer is "**Were the books not being read by the children?**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The formula for forming negative passive sentences is subject + auxiliary verb “to be” (am/is/are) + ne
